submission.justification: Provisional recommendation of Algorithm-L3 at a 30 GeV threshold. It has the highest recorded signal efficiency in the scan (92.693%, versus 83.663% for L2 and 72.256% for L1 at 30 GeV), and 30 GeV is the best threshold for L3 within the 20-60 GeV range. The recommendation is not fully verified against the brief's constraints. (1) Latency: the hard 4.0 us FPGA latency limit cannot be checked. No candidate has a stated latency in the candidate specs or project documents, so no candidate was excluded and L3 is not confirmed to meet the limit. The L3 choice must be checked against the FPGA latency before deployment, and if it exceeds 4.0 us the fallback is L2 at 40 GeV (85.424%), which also still lacks a verified latency. (2) Rate: the efficiency scan has no trigger-rate figures, so none of the points has been shown to fit the 8 kHz allocation. The efficiency ranking is therefore a comparison at unknown rate, and the threshold choice should be confirmed against the rate before use. Because the efficiency gain is measured at unknown rate and latency is unverified, this recommendation should be treated as conditional.
